hooks.name: ReadMonotonicTime
hooks.portable_default: Return the architectural cycle counter.
profile_obligations: Define the time unit, monotonicity guarantee, rollover behavior, and reset value.

hooks.name: FloatingExponential
hooks.portable_default: Return the input real value.
profile_obligations: Define accuracy, exceptional inputs, overflow, underflow, and rounding.

hooks.name: FloatingRoundNearest
hooks.portable_default: Round to nearest with halfway cases away from zero.
profile_obligations: Define tie handling and prove consistency with the selected scalar numeric profile.

hooks.name: ScalarFPBinaryProfile
hooks.portable_default: Return the normalized left operand and no new flags.
profile_obligations: Define correctly rounded ADD, SUB, MUL, and DIV raw results for every accepted scalar format.
Define NaN propagation, infinities, subnormals, signed zero, and NV/DZ/OF/UF/NX flags.

hooks.name: ScalarFPUnaryProfile
hooks.portable_default: Return the normalized operand and no new flags.
profile_obligations: Define correctly rounded SQRT, reciprocal, and exponential raw results.
Define exceptional inputs, approximation guarantees, and NV/DZ/OF/UF/NX flags.

hooks.name: ScalarFPFusedProfile
hooks.portable_default: Return the normalized addend and no new flags.
profile_obligations: Define single-rounding fused multiply-add variants for every accepted scalar format.
Define NaN propagation and NV/OF/UF/NX flags.

hooks.name: ScalarFPToIntegerProfile
hooks.portable_default: Return the source payload before normative destination-width normalization and no new flags.
profile_obligations: Define rounding, saturation or indefinite results, exceptional inputs, and NV/NX flags for every accepted integer destination type.

hooks.name: ScalarFPConvertProfile
hooks.portable_default: Return the source payload before normative floating destination-width normalization and no new flags.
profile_obligations: Define floating format conversion, rounding, NaN payload handling, overflow, underflow, and flags for every accepted destination type.

hooks.name: ScalarIntegerToFPProfile
hooks.portable_default: Return the normalized integer source payload before normative floating destination-width normalization and no new flags.
profile_obligations: Define integer-to-floating conversion, rounding, overflow, underflow, and NX flags for every accepted destination type.

hooks.name: TileSquareRoot
hooks.portable_default: Return the raw input payload.
profile_obligations: Define per-data-type square-root encoding, accuracy, exceptional inputs, and rounding.

hooks.name: TileLogarithm
hooks.portable_default: Return the raw input payload.
profile_obligations: Define per-data-type logarithm encoding, base, accuracy, exceptional inputs, and rounding.

hooks.name: TileReciprocal
hooks.portable_default: Apply unsigned bitvector reciprocal and reject zero.
profile_obligations: Define per-data-type reciprocal encoding, accuracy, division-by-zero behavior, and rounding.

hooks.name: TileExponential
hooks.portable_default: Return the raw input payload.
profile_obligations: Define per-data-type exponential encoding, base, accuracy, overflow, underflow, and rounding.

hooks.name: TileExpDifference
hooks.portable_default: Subtract the raw right payload from the raw left payload.
profile_obligations: Define the exponential-difference formula, intermediate precision, exceptional inputs, and rounding for every accepted floating type.

hooks.name: TileProfileConvert
hooks.portable_default: Preserve the raw payload for conversions involving a floating type.
profile_obligations: Define every accepted floating/integer type pair, destination packing, rounding, saturation, and exceptional values.

hooks.name: TileProfileQuantize
hooks.portable_default: Apply unsigned bitvector division by scale, add zero point, and normalize to the destination integer width.
profile_obligations: Define scale and zero-point encodings, rounding, clamping, saturation, per-type legality, and zero-scale behavior.

hooks.name: TileProfileDequantize
hooks.portable_default: Subtract the zero point and multiply by scale as raw bitvectors.
profile_obligations: Define scale and zero-point encodings, intermediate precision, destination rounding, and per-type legality.

hooks.name: AtomicAddress
hooks.portable_default: Preserve the decoded address for both address-class hint values.
profile_obligations: Define address-class selection, translation, fault priority, and interaction with reservations for both hint values.

hooks.name: TranslateDataAddress
hooks.portable_default: Use identity translation for scalar data accesses.
profile_obligations: Define translation inputs, address-space selection, access-size behavior, and translation-fault priority.

hooks.name: DataAccessPermitted
hooks.portable_default: Permit reads and writes wholly contained in the bounded model memory.
profile_obligations: Define read/write permissions, bounds, access-size behavior, and permission-fault priority.

hooks.name: TileProfileBinary
hooks.portable_default: Apply the operation with deterministic raw bitvector arithmetic.
profile_obligations: Define per-type arithmetic, rounding, exceptional values, overflow, and underflow.

hooks.name: TileProfileUnary
hooks.portable_default: Apply the operation with deterministic raw bitvector behavior.
profile_obligations: Define per-type arithmetic, rounding, exceptional values, overflow, and underflow.

hooks.name: TileProfileAxpy
hooks.portable_default: Multiply and add raw bitvectors at architectural word width.
profile_obligations: Define per-type multiplication, addition, intermediate precision, rounding, and exceptional values.

hooks.name: TileProfileCompare
hooks.portable_default: Compare raw payloads with deterministic signed or equality relations.
profile_obligations: Define per-type ordering, equality, NaN behavior, signed-zero behavior, and unordered results.

hooks.name: TileProfileReductionInitial
hooks.portable_default: Initialize reduction accumulators from the first raw payload.
profile_obligations: Define per-type identities, first-element handling, exceptional values, and empty-input legality.

hooks.name: TileProfileReductionStep
hooks.portable_default: Apply raw bitvector sum, product, minimum, maximum, or argument selection.
profile_obligations: Define per-type accumulation precision, rounding, ordering, exceptional values, and tie selection.

hooks.name: TileProfileExpand
hooks.portable_default: Apply the selected expansion operation with raw bitvector arithmetic.
profile_obligations: Define per-type broadcast arithmetic, rounding, exceptional values, overflow, and underflow.

hooks.name: TileProfilePartialValue
hooks.portable_default: Apply partial arithmetic with deterministic raw bitvector operations.
profile_obligations: Define per-type partial arithmetic, rounding, exceptional values, and missing-source behavior.

hooks.name: TileProfileOrderLeft
hooks.portable_default: Order raw payloads as signed words and prefer the left operand on ties.
profile_obligations: Define per-type ordering, NaN behavior, signed-zero behavior, stability, and tie selection.

hooks.name: TileProfileMatrixAccumulate
hooks.portable_default: Multiply raw payloads and accumulate at architectural word width.
profile_obligations: Define accepted type triples, product and accumulator widths, rounding, saturation, and exceptional values.

hooks.name: TileProfileMatrixBias
hooks.portable_default: Add bias and destination raw payloads at architectural word width.
profile_obligations: Define accepted type pairs, bias conversion, rounding, saturation, and exceptional values.

hooks.name: TileProfileMatrixScale
hooks.portable_default: Apply row and column scales with raw word-width multiplication.
profile_obligations: Define accepted type triples, scale encodings, intermediate precision, rounding, saturation, and exceptional values.
